root_cause: BlueZ zombie session after overnight BLE disconnect. Service could not reconnect because stale BlueZ cache entry blocked new connection.
fix_code: Added bluetoothctl remove before EACH connection attempt (mirrors wit-ble-direct pattern)
Added initial BlueZ clear at startup (prevents stale session from previous run)
Lowered L2_THRESHOLD from 20 to 10 (faster systemd restart cycle on persistent failure)

new_features.connection_cleanup: [BLE_CLEANUP] BlueZ cache cleared before each attempt

next_recommended: Monitor calypso-direct.log over next 24h for any recurrence
